title: One to two craft brought down per year at black sites

tellings.quote: There's also claims by Greer and others that at some of these black sites, um, one to two craft are brought down a year.

plain: At certain black sites, meaning secret military facilities, one or two unknown craft are brought down every year. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells Michels this is a claim made by a man named Steven Greer and others, and he passes it on as their claim. If true, it would mean the military is not just finding crashed craft but bringing them down regularly.
